adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that `TopicEmbed.import_remote` at line 48 calls `open(url).read` and `Readability::Document.new` without any exception handling. Looking at the diff, this method is called from `TopicRetriever.fetch_http` (line 53 of topic_retriever.rb) and from `Jobs::PollFeed.poll_feed`. When called via the embed controller flow (embed_controller.rb line 14), if the topic doesn't exist, it enqueues `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` which calls `TopicRetriever.new(...).retrieve`. If `import_remote` throws an exception (network error, invalid HTML, etc.), no error state is recorded, and the embed view will continue showing 'Loading Discussion...' with a 30-second reload (loading.html.erb). The user would see an infinite loading loop for URLs that consistently fail to fetch/parse.
